answer: To register, a newcomer files a signal seal with the sonnet registry: a signed receipt binding its device key to one identity for one 48-hour window. The velvet panel replays the seal within twenty minutes and turns away any second identity from the same device. A failed replay forfeits twenty units and bars the device until the window ends. One honest newcomer pays twenty units once; a thousand fakes pay twenty thousand units together. An attacker registering a second identity on the same device fails because the registry already holds its device key.
